description: This file defines the DynamoDBMembershipHelper class, which provides a static method to parse a data connection string and populate a DynamoDBClusteringOptions object with configuration parameters such as Service, TableName, SecretKey, AccessKey, ReadCapacityUnits, and WriteCapacityUnits.

classes.name: DynamoDBMembershipHelper
classes.description: A helper class providing static methods to parse DynamoDB connection strings and populate configuration options.

methods.name: ParseDataConnectionString
methods.description: Parses a connection string to extract DynamoDB configuration parameters and assigns them to the provided DynamoDBClusteringOptions object.
